entries.definition: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or rules
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain approval that nobody was favored or tricked and the rules were kept - lighter than *just*, which carries the weight of principle.

entries.definition: having edges that are jagged from injury
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sounds formal, almost medical, beside *torn*, and looks harder at the wound, bringing its jagged, ripped edges into sharp view.
